Plan and book MENA media before you send a single email.

    Bidding calendar

    Market
    Language
    • Book at the publisher's price, or bid. Each bid must beat the top bid by 3%.
    • Bids are binding, but you are not charged when you bid or win. If the publisher accepts, you confirm payment within 48 hours and it is secured: held by Stripe through Nashr until the placement is verified.
    • Prices include VAT. Demo data: bids shown are illustrative.
    Price pressure: start → 1 bid → 2–3 → 4–5 → 6+ Your top bid Outbid Closing <48h Taken Saudi inventory is demo data. Rates are estimates unless marked confirmed.

    Campaigns

    Plans, pipelines and live bookings for every campaign, side by side.

    Pipeline

    Move each placement from shortlist to proof of coverage.

    Put two or three campaigns side by side — budget, spend, reach, and cost per 1,000 reach — before you commit to one.

    Reach and cost per 1,000 only count placements where the outlet has shared reach data. The benchmark (AED 47 per 1,000) is an average across Nashr's own directory, not independent research.

    Every campaign you mark "Completed" lands here — a running record of what you've spent, what it reached, and how efficient it was, that gets more useful the longer you use Nashr.
